name: Extus Narr
description: Leader of the Oriq who wants Zimone's knowledge to control time and space.

description_citations.text: "Zimone Wola". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tavver, an Oriq agent, hides in a tunnel beneath the Biblioplex after failing his mission.
timeline.quote: Tavver didn't know how long he had waited in that cramped tunnel beneath the Biblioplex

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Tavver recalls the professor with violet eyes who meant to kill him in a fight over a book Extus wanted.
timeline.quote: Tavver had seen true darkness in that professor's violet eyes.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus fails a fourth time to brew a potion in his cave.
timeline.quote: That was the fourth failure.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus broods over Oriq agents drained of life for the ritual, which still was not enough.
timeline.quote: every last bit of life drained from their bodies, and it wasn't enough

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus decides the Snarl beneath the school could give him the power he needs.
timeline.quote: that overlapping tangle of power hidden away below the school would offer more than enough

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus learns of a beast-calling stranger and says to let him come.
timeline.quote: Let him come.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina warns Lukka that Extus fights only for himself.
timeline.quote: Do you think Extus is going to change all that?

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus orders the Oriq to attack as Lukka controls the mage hunters.
timeline.quote: Commence the attack.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Onyx explains Extus leads the Oriq and is responsible for the attack.
timeline.quote: The man responsible for all of this. The leader of the Oriq.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus receives a book found in the East Wing from Tavver.
timeline.quote: I found it in the East Wing, just as you said, sir.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus swings Tavver into a Silverquill student's dark spell and then kills the student.
timeline.quote: Extus tightened his grip on Tavver's arm and pulled him close, spinning him into the spell's path.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus blasts open the Hall of Oracles doors.
timeline.quote: he blasted the doors off their hinges and stepped inside

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus sees the Snarl hanging over ancient containment circles.
timeline.quote: The Strixhaven Snarl hung in the air, tendrils of energy whipping and snapping around the hall.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Oriq agents arrange books and scrolls, and Extus begins to read the ritual.
timeline.quote: Extus began to read.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana senses that Extus has bound himself to the Snarl.
timeline.quote: He's already bound himself to the Snarl.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus hits Liliana with a forced translocation spell that sends her to the forest outside campus.
timeline.quote: Forced translocation magic.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus freezes and shatters Rowan's lightning and breaks Will's ice shield.
timeline.quote: shattering on the ground as if made of glass

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Blood pools across the floor and the Snarl turns from blue to deep red.
timeline.quote: Where it had glowed blue before, now it shone a deep red.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus calls upon the Blood Avatar to unleash its wrath.
timeline.quote: Rise, Great One! I call upon you, Blood Avatar!

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan realizes the avatar was Extus's plan all along.
timeline.quote: This was Extus's plan all along.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus gloats before the oracle statues as the Blood Avatar rises.
timeline.quote: He whirled, gesturing wildly at the statues surrounding him.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will's ice shards at Extus are blown apart by Rowan's lightning.
timeline.quote: a bolt of lightning cracked through the shards, detonating them

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus sees the Blood Avatar faltering as the Snarl's energy flows into Rowan.
timeline.quote: The creature was moving in jerks and fits, the red light of the Snarl flickering wildly behind it.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan blasts Extus with fire that hurls him against the wall.
timeline.quote: the spell crashed into him, sending him flying through the air, robes coiling with smoke

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus dismisses Rowan's ambition and returns to his ritual.
timeline.quote: But I've come too far to be stopped by the likes of you.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will casts a red halo control spell on the Blood Avatar's head.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, a red halo of light snapped into place around the Blood Avatar's helmed head.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The controlled Blood Avatar crushes Extus.
timeline.quote: one of the massive hands of the Blood Avatar closed around him with an awful crunching sound

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone wakes to find Extus and Pita, who introduce themselves.
timeline.quote: My name is Extus

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus says they have followed Zimone for years and know about the packages.
timeline.quote: We have followed you for years.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus offers to share what the Oriq knows about the Conjecture to control the universe.
timeline.quote: And we'll tell you what we know, and together, we can control the universe.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Zimone refuses and lashes Extus and Pita into a wall with the ribbon braid.
timeline.quote: whips the braid of blue-green ribbons at the two men, sending them crashing into the wall at the far end of the room

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Dean Kianne bursts in with Amaka and Nnanyielugo.
timeline.quote: Get away from her!

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Kianne redirects Extus's fireball, and Zimone stops and douses it with her braid.
timeline.quote: Zimone swirls the braid of blue-green ribbons, weaving it into the tiny cracks of time and space

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus departs, saying they will meet again.
timeline.quote: Though I trust we'll meet again, Zimone Wola.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus, seeking vengeance, has infiltrators recruit promising mage-students from the halls he sought to destroy.
timeline.quote: His infiltrators recruited promising mage-students from the very halls he sought to destroy.

citation.text: Tempted by the Oriq (Strixhaven: School of Mages Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Extus takes control of the Oriq with a lethal strike, his first step toward vengeance.
timeline.quote: With one lethal strike, Extus took control of the Oriq and took his first step towards vengeance.

citation.text: Rise of Extus (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Extus begins his research into forbidden Blood Age magic.
timeline.quote: Strixhaven forbade all magic from the Blood Age, so that is where Extus began his research.

citation.text: Plumb the Forbidden (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx urges the twins to prepare for Extus.
timeline.quote: Professor Onyx urged the twins to prepare for the dark mage Extus

citation.text: Professor's Warning (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The twins each research spells to defeat Extus.
timeline.quote: The twins each researched spells to defeat Extus in their own way.

citation.text: Practical Research (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Extus stands before his alma mater and commands the mage hunters to unfold.
timeline.quote: At his command, the mage hunters unfolded.

citation.text: Mage Hunters' Onslaught (Strixhaven: School of Mages, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Extus Narr summons the Blood Avatar during the Oriq Attack on Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: Extus Narr summoned a creature from the Blood Age known as the Blood Avatar .

citation.text: "Avatar", section "The Blood Avatar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Oriq attack Extus Narr infiltrates the Biblioplex and summons the Blood Avatar in the Hall of Oracles.
timeline.quote: During the Oriq Attack on Strixhaven , Extus Narr infiltrated the Biblioplex and summoned the Blood Avatar in the Hall of Oracles.

citation.text: "Biblioplex", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rowan and Will Kenrith defeat Extus Narr and the Blood Avatar, but the Hall of Oracles collapses.
timeline.quote: Extus Narr and the Blood Avatar were defeated by Rowan and Will Kenrith , but the Hall of Oracles collapsed from the magical strain and was left in ruin.

citation.text: "Biblioplex", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: An Oriq leader translocates Liliana away before the Blood Avatar fight.
timeline.quote: Liliana was translocated away by the Oriq leader

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "On Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: On Arcavios Lukka bonds with Mila, is captured by the Oriq and meets their leader Extus Narr, who offers a trade.
timeline.quote: Extus explained that there were things he could teach Lukka and proposed a trade.

citation.text: "Lukka", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rowan and Will face Extus Narr and the Blood Avatar beneath the Biblioplex and join powers so Will wrests control of the Avatar, which kills Extus but gravely wounds Will.
timeline.quote: The Avatar killed the Oriq leader and was sent back from where it came, but not before gravely wounding Will.

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan face Extus Narr and the Blood Avatar beneath the Biblioplex; Will gains control of the Avatar, which kills Extus Narr but severs Will's leg.
timeline.quote: The Avatar killed the Oriq leader and was sent back from where it came, but not before it hacked off Will's leg.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "Arcavios". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Oriq capture Zimone, and Extus Narr wants her knowledge; Zimone rescues him when Kianne and her friends come, showing she has mastered time and space.
timeline.quote: she demonstrated that she had mastered time and space, and thus had solved the Vorzani Conjecture

citation.text: "Zimone Wola", section "Captured by the Oriq". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Extus is passed over for the role of Oracle by the Founder Dragons.
timeline.quote: he was passed over for the role of Oracle by the five Founder Dragons

citation.text: "Extus Narr", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Extus takes control of the Oriq and seeks vengeance, trying to awaken the Blood Avatar.
timeline.quote: he took control of the Oriq and began his path for vengeance

citation.text: "Extus Narr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka helps the Oriq by distracting Kasmina and coordinating a mage hunter attack on Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: Lukka helped the Oriq by distracting Kasmina and coordinating a mage hunter attack on Strixhaven.

citation.text: "Extus Narr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the chaos, Extus descends into the Hall of Oracles to harness the Snarl.
timeline.quote: Extus entered the Biblioplex and descended into the Hall of Oracles

citation.text: "Extus Narr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Onyx is translocated away and the Kenrith twins are kept at bay.
timeline.quote: the professor was translocated away while the twins were easily kept at bay

citation.text: "Extus Narr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Extus summons the Blood Avatar and is killed by it.
timeline.quote: he was killed in the fight by the very creature he had summoned

citation.text: "Extus Narr", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Lukka is captured and taken to Extus Narr, who proposes a trade.
timeline.quote: Lukka was captured and taken to the leader of the Oriq

citation.text: "Oriq", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Professors and the Founder Dragons defend Strixhaven but cannot stop Narr reaching the Hall of Oracles to start the Blood Avatar ritual.
timeline.quote: unable to prevent Extus Narr from reaching the Hall of Oracles

citation.text: "Oriq", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Blood Avatar kills Narr, and the Kenrith twins contain the monster.
timeline.quote: Narr was killed by the avatar

citation.text: "Oriq", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Oriq forces led by Extus Narr attacked Strixhaven with Mage Hunters.
timeline.quote: the Strixhaven campus in Arcavios was subjected to a large-scale assault by Oriq forces led by Extus Narr

citation.text: "Oriq attack on Strixhaven", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Extus infiltrated the Biblioplex and Tavver sacrificed himself to impede him.
timeline.quote: Extus Narr had infiltrated the Biblioplex

citation.text: "Oriq attack on Strixhaven", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Extus summoned the Blood Avatar in the Hall of Oracles.
timeline.quote: Extus succeeded in summoning a massive entity called the Blood Avatar

citation.text: "Oriq attack on Strixhaven", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan sealed the Blood Avatar; Extus was crushed and the Avatar cut off Will's leg.
timeline.quote: Extus was subsequently killed when crushed by the Avatar's hand

citation.text: "Oriq attack on Strixhaven", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: "Episode 2: Lessons" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Mar 2021.

pages_say.description: The leader of the Oriq who orders the attack on the school with mage hunters under Lukka's control.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

pages_say.description: The masked leader of the Oriq who sacrifices his own agent, binds himself to the Snarl, and summons the Blood Avatar.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

pages_say.description: The Oriq leader who summons the Blood Avatar and is crushed by it.

citation.text: "Blue-Green Ribbons" by Innocent Chizaram Ilo. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 23 Apr 2021.
